_how_to_update: TO LOG AN INCIDENT: add an entry to the 'incidents' array below with date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, status (one of: investigating | identified | monitoring | resolved), and details in plain language. Keep entries honest — no fake uptime claims. Newest entries go LAST in this file; the status tab renders newest first automatically. Then re-deploy. This tab is superadmin-only.
_note: Seeded 2026-10-24 when the status page launched. Past history before this page existed is intentionally not reconstructed.
